chapter: Danny's rise through New York bands to Cab Calloway
title: Jack Carter, Noble Sissle's drummer and the bar-owning brothers
summary: Jack Carter had big diamonds, a bar on Seventh Avenue and brothers who all owned Harlem gin mills.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah. See, but you had to be competent and you had not to be an obnoxious character. They'd put up with you, but after a while you'd head down with that. You'd find out... If you worked with Noble Sissle, there was Jack Carter on the drums, big diamonds on his finger. He wasn't no Chick Webb, but he had rhythm and he had personality. He was brash.
He wound up with a bar on Seventh Avenue didn't he?
He had a bar, and a whole lot of money at all times.
He had a whole...about five of them brothers. And all them were into things. They were all Night People. Three of the brothers had gin-mills in Harlem, three different brothers had barrooms.
